mostWorthwhile.text: The first powered test was most worthwhile: it showed the invented tile rising and the tether stopping it.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the crossbars and seating the tile were clear but felt like straightforward assembly without much new to consider.

surprise.text: Adding the test weight slowed the tile, but did not establish a clear numerical limit as I had expected.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the goals gave a concrete next operation, and the post-and-nut order had a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the limited, tethered lift is used in the fair, though this chapter offered few decisions beyond following the construction steps.
